Events.Name: Coding Support & DSA (Data Structure Algoritms) introduction workshop
Events.About: Need help with programming or want to improve your problem-solving skills? Drop in for a friendly, beginner-friendly session where you can get help with coding, learn about Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), explore Big O notation and hash maps, and work through practice problems with support from fellow students. Bring your questions, work on your own code, or learn something new!
